ticket_text: ppadevs/ddd: relax doctrine/orm constraint so the package installs on PHP 8.5 + Symfony 7.4 + Doctrine ORM 3
summary: ppadevs/ddd pins doctrine/orm ^2.11, which cannot coexist with Doctrine ORM 3 — the ORM the new PHP 8.5 / Symfony 7.4 stack uses. Relax the constraint to ^2.11 || ^3.0 (code is already compatible), release v26.41.0 (major jump by design — ^2.x consumers stay behind), publish.
